_comment: Issue #207: the WIRING, not the rule. These break the picker in AddonManager.cpp and watch probe_docbridge go red - the reported failure was a question nobody asked, so the assertion that has to discriminate is 'the gate is called at all'.

mutants.name: picker-never-asks-about-format
mutants._why: The bug exactly as reported: title alone decides, and the EPUB release wins the audiobook search.

mutants.name: picker-asks-on-behalf-of-the-wrong-shelf
mutants._why: The catalog is the only side that knows what was wanted; ask it nothing and the gate is inert.

mutants.name: picker-refuses-everything
mutants._why: The other direction: a gate that refuses format-silent releases passes the two refusal cases and breaks every search that works today.

mutants.name: format-gate-runs-before-the-title-gate
mutants._why: Order matters for the LOG, which is how the next report will be read: a candidate refused on title must not be counted as a format refusal.
mutants.find:
if (!titleOk(it.title)) { ++rejected; continue; }
            if (!CatalogMatch::formatMatchesRequest(wantFormat, wantTitle, it.title)) { ++rejectedFormat; continue; }
mutants.replace:
if (!CatalogMatch::formatMatchesRequest(wantFormat, wantTitle, it.title)) { ++rejectedFormat; continue; }
            if (!titleOk(it.title)) { ++rejected; continue; }

mutants.name: the-release-is-never-expanded
mutants._why: #214: the whole defect, as one line. The bridge goes back to resolving a release of forty parts to a single link, and the app plays whichever file the source returned first -- with every pure assertion in probe_remotebook still green, which is exactly how this hid.

mutants.name: the-file-list-is-taken-as-the-source-gave-it
mutants._why: #214: the expansion happens but nothing filters or orders it, so cover.jpg is a queue entry and the book starts at part ten.

mutants.name: a-release-with-no-audio-is-not-reported-as-one
mutants._why: #214/#207: an ebook release that won an audiobook search would come back as a plain miss, so the user is told 'no copies were found' about a copy that was found -- and the release is one bad fallback away from being staged as playback again.

mutants.name: a-single-file-recording-is-routed-through-the-queue
mutants._why: #214: the one regression the fix could cause. An .m4b already worked; sending it down the new path changes what its resume position is keyed by, silently, for every listener who already had one.
mutants.find: if (parts.size() == 1) { playWholeRelease("it is a single file"); return; }
mutants.replace: if (parts.size() == 0) { playWholeRelease("it is a single file"); return; }
